title: Small previews load the ORIGINAL file: Landing card blank, History list slow on huge images
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-962 (Big photos). Two sites get the ORIGINAL media instead of the sidecar thumbPath: findRecentProjectThumbnail (routes/projects.js) for the Landing recent-project card, and MpiHistoryList.js (~:138-141, images only). On Big Photos Test (2026-09-28) Fabio saw the Landing card blank (newest = a 32K import), the 16K card's History rows paint top-down one at a time before the canvas loaded, and the 32K row broken. Fix: prefer thumbPath, original only as fallback. Brief in brief.md.
